_doc: Experiment / falsification ledger — the gauntlet logbook of the building-in-public flywheel (see memory building-in-public-flywheel-surface-roles). One JSON object per line; append-only, never rewrite history. Each entry records a falsification experiment run against an artifact (counterpart-gauntlet, dual-bar-raiser, provenance audit, meta-audit) and — critically — what got FALSIFIED, including over-flags where the test itself was proven wrong by source. Fields: id, date, surface, counterpart, experiment, hypothesis, method, result, falsified[] (real defects found+fixed), over_flags_rejected[] (test proven wrong vs source), disposition, artifacts, lesson, cost.

experiment: counterpart-gauntlet (7 persona facets) -> adversarial verify -> dual-bar-raiser -> synthesis, then a deterministic provenance audit vs the full Granola transcript
hypothesis: The 3-tab codex (Read / Instrument / Blueprint) is send-worthy: every counterpart quote is verbatim-grounded, no overclaim, register-fit, and forwardable in a referral-hold.
method: 17-agent background Workflow (wf_8fb78226-084): 6 Kam facets + 1 Francis facet at high burden of proof; each facet's flags adversarially verified against source; both survivors gated by 2 independent bar-raisers (guest-test + honesty/register); 1 synthesis. Then human re-verification of every surviving flag against the FULL transcript (re-pulled — scratchpad copy had been truncated) + both LinkedIn profiles + a WebFetch of the cited Francis essay. Deterministic substring checker: scratchpad/provcheck.py.
falsified: keiretsu relationship asserted as flat fact ('it is already your org chart') -> softened to the sourced portfolio listing
'you named the company after the principle' misattributed Francis's Invisible/essay to Kam -> essay -> Francis, Kam's real Invisible co-founder tie kept
peak beat framed a relayed Auren-Hoffman tweet as Kam 'naming the pain live, in the same breath' -> reframed as relayed tweet + fixed timing; removed Tab1/Tab3 contradiction
orthogonal-echo beat spliced Ascendancy + a separate history side-project into one attributed quote -> unwelded
HIT scored on a retrofitted 'automation under human specialization' framing -> regrounded in Kam's actual 'product bridge / composable components' words
'Lossless translation' overclaim (Zach only said NARROW the loss) -> renamed 'Narrowing the loss'; brand rule refusal-to-overclaim
altitude ladder rendered 4 rungs but prose/transcript name 5 -> restored the Tactical rung
honest-ceiling invented a causal frame ('when I offered to score your confidence') -> corrected to 'when I floated filing a bet'
author's vocabulary in counterpart's mouth (kam schema objects, Francis register line, referral handle) -> regrounded to source wording

over_flags_rejected.flag: peak-beat ME line 'geometric approach / field state / dyad / triad' called a fabrication (ranked #1 top-fix)
over_flags_rejected.why_rejected: verbatim Zach on the FULL transcript; the gauntlet ran on a truncated scratchpad copy that dropped the passage

over_flags_rejected.flag: 'six million pages' (Nalanda/Eternity) called an invented figure
over_flags_rejected.why_rejected: grounded verbatim in Francis Pedraza's LinkedIn profile

over_flags_rejected.flag: 'Kam has no Invisible history / a friend almost joined' -> proposed telling Kam he almost built Invisible
over_flags_rejected.why_rejected: Kam's profile lists him Co-Founder of Invisible; Zach references it on the tape ('with invisible... how many areas you were across'). Applying the prescribed fix would have introduced a NEW fabrication.

disposition: All 10 real fixes applied and redeployed live; detector clean, 0 em-dashes, provenance re-verified vs full transcript (only external-verified Francis quote + labeled ME-paraphrase lines remain non-verbatim by design). Ship-worthy; send held pending Kam's referral-hold + an open weight/trim call.
lesson: A gauntlet is only as honest as its source-of-truth: an abbreviated transcript manufactured a top-ranked false 'fabrication' flag. Deterministic re-verification of every surviving flag against the FULL primary source (transcript + profiles + a source fetch) is non-optional — it caught 3 over-flags, one of which would have replaced a truth with a new fabrication if blind-applied.
